text:
anya-partnerships: Quick heads-up 1 1 coordinating marketplace dry run for Snowflake + Databricks + Milvus connector. Need an owner for the marketplace checklist, embargo window, and field demo creds.

ada-engineering: I can own packaging, connector artifacts, and the smoke perf tests. Planning to push a staging bundle tonight. Ill need the partner schema mapping and sample dataset to validate transforms.

lucy-gtm: Ill own partner comms and the listing copy. Recommend a soft internal heads-up 48h before public listing so field can prep.

rachel-fieldops: 48h works if we get staging creds + sample data by Thu 10am. Also require a rollback runbook and the USB quickstart image with SHA256.

devon-legal: For co-marketing assets: please upload drafts to the shared drive and tag me. We require partner logo release and 72h lead time for approvals; if you want a Fri listing, get assets in by Tues AM or we need explicit waiver.

ada-engineering: Pushing to staging now: ``deploy --bundle snow-dbx-milvus --env staging --tag v1.0.0-rc``. Will post the staging URL when available.

marketplace-bot: staging package uploaded: https://marketplace.staging/redwood/bundles/snow-dbx-milvus/v1.0.0-rc

anya-partnerships: Proposed timeline: internal dry run Mon -> partner dry run Wed -> public listing Fri. Legal notes may force listing to Mon next week; thoughts?

lucy-gtm: If legal needs 72h, pushing listing to Mon makes sense. Alternatively ask partner for written waiver to keep Fri. Either way, field gets a 48h soft-announce.

devon-legal: We can expedite with an emailed partner OK; Ill draft an addendum for embargo/dates and circulate by Tue noon if you send proposed dates now.

rachel-fieldops: Also request: add a lightweight debug toggle for demos (DEBUG=true) and a simple logs.md for field engineers. Need a telemetry ingest endpoint for demo telemetry.

ada-engineering: Will add DEBUG=true toggle and a concise logs.md. Adding telemetry config sample to the manifest (example: telemetry.endpoint=https://ingest.staging.redwood/teams/xyz). Will also include SHA256 checksums for any images.

lucy-gtm: Action items recap: 1) @ada-engineering - push SKUs, checksums, manifest, and telemetry sample to staging by Tue EOD. 2) @rachel-fieldops - confirm demo creds + rollback runbook by Wed AM. 3) @devon-legal - draft addendum and review co-marketing assets, target Tue noon. 4) @anya-partnerships & @lucy-gtm - coordinate partner comms and internal soft-announce.

anya-partnerships: Ill create the marketplace checklist doc and share the link here. Scheduling a 30-min alignment call tomorrow at 9:30am to walk through gaps. Tagging this thread "marketplace-milvus-orch" for follow-ups.

lucy-gtm: +1 to the call.

devon-legal: +1.

rachel-fieldops: +1.

ada-engineering: +1, will be on the call and bring the staging permalinks.

marketplace-bot: reminder: marketplace listing requires product page, pricing tiers, support contacts, security attestation, and media assets. See /docs/marketplace/requirements for details.
